evidence: app/package.json:9-14 — @solidjs/start 2.1.0, router 1.0.0, solid-js 1.9.17, vite 8, nitro v3 RC: the exact current stack per solid-start releases (Start 2.1.0, 2026-10-22) and the v2 migration guide
app/vite.config.ts:7 — solidStart({ ssr: false, devOverlay: false }) + nitro() from nitro/vite is the current v2 config shape (docs.solidjs.com solid-start/v2 migrating-from-v1)
app/src/routes/api-proxy/[...path].ts:1 — APIEvent from @solidjs/start/server is the documented current v2 API-route type
app/src/routes/moves/[name].tsx:11 — every route loads data with raw createResource instead of the v2-documented query + createAsync (docs.solidjs.com solid-start/v2 data-fetching)

app/src/routes/index.tsx:132, app/src/components/PokemonCard.tsx:35 — .map() in JSX instead of <For>, non-idiomatic for Solid's fine-grained reactivity
latest_apis.rationale: Framework versions and config are exactly the current stable generation (Start 2.1, router 1.0, solid 1.9 — correctly not the 2.0 RC, Nitro v3 RC required by Start v2), but data loading uses the older createResource-plus-hand-rolled-cache pattern where the current documented primitive is query/createAsync.

evidence: app/src/routes/api-proxy/[...path].ts:10-16 — server routes use fetch, Headers, Response, Request natively
app/src/routes/index.tsx:9-14 — queryHref builds URLs with URLSearchParams; filters are native input[type=search]/select (lines 98-126)
app/src/components/PokemonCard.tsx:17-21 — loading="lazy" with explicit width/height on sprites
app/src/app.css:4-9 — consumes design custom properties (--color-bg etc.) from tokens.css throughout; single @media query at app.css:618
app/src/lib/api.ts:53 vs :60 — idFromUrl parses the ID with a regex while apiPathFromUrl uses new URL(): inconsistent, hand-rolled where URL would do
app/src/routes/media/[...path].ts:13 — proxies sprites through arrayBuffer() (full buffering) instead of streaming res.body through a Response
platform.rationale: Reaches for the platform (fetch/Response/Headers/URL/URLSearchParams, native form controls, lazy images, CSS custom properties) with no polyfills or redundant libs; a couple of spots buffer responses and parse URLs by regex where the platform would stream and parse.

evidence: app/package.json:8-14 — exactly six deps, all framework-mandated (@solidjs/start, router, meta, solid-js, vite, nitro), matching the official v2 install list; no CSS/UI/state/fetch helper packages
app/package.json:14 — nitro ^3.0.261029-rc is the current Nitro v3 RC (published 2026-10-29, npmjs.com/package/nitro); Nitro v3 has no stable release and Start v2 requires it
app/package.json:10 — solid-js ^1.9.17 stays on the stable 1.9 line rather than the solid-js 2.0 RC, correct for production
app/src/app.css — hand-written plain CSS with no CSS framework, per spec
dependencies.rationale: Minimal and modern: only the framework's own required stack at current versions, zero application-level packages, with the one RC (nitro) being ecosystem-mandated rather than a choice.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts + app/src/lib/data.ts — all API access and aggregation centralized in two modules; routes consume named view-model functions (getPokemonPage, getMovePage, etc.)
app/src/lib/data.ts:186-199 — PokemonPageData interface types the component boundary, but species/pokemon/evolution/versionGroups/evolutionRoot/moves are all any
app/src/lib/data.ts:28-31 — module-level promise memoization (speciesPromise, generationPromise, …) plus api.ts:21-23 TTL cache: bespoke caching machinery to rework if requirements or framework move
app/src/routes/api-proxy/[...path].ts:3 and app/src/routes/media/[...path].ts:3 — API_BASE env handling duplicated in both proxy routes
app/package.json:5-14 — no devDependencies: no typescript or typecheck script despite tsconfig.json and interfaces, so the 96 typeLines are never verified
app/src/app.tsx:15 — document.documentElement.lang side effect, redundant with entry-server.tsx:7's <html lang="en">
app/src/routes/index.tsx:64-65, pokemon/[name].tsx:41-47, types/[name].tsx:23-28 — copy-pasted per-route loading fallback shells
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is well-centralized and config is single-place, so most framework moves touch few files; but pervasive any at the API boundary, hand-rolled caching that duplicates router functionality, and no typechecking mean API or requirement drift won't be caught and the bespoke machinery needs rework.

findings.issue: View-model interfaces exist but raw API payloads flow through as any (species, pokemon, evolutionRoot, versionGroups all any), so API shape changes compile silently
findings.suggestion: Define minimal response types (or zod-style parsing) for the endpoints actually consumed in getPokemonPage/getMovePage/getAbilityPage/getTypePage

findings.issue: Hand-rolled TTL cache, inflight dedupe and module-level promise memoization (data.ts:28-31) re-implement what @solidjs/router's query + createAsync provide as the documented v2 data-loading pattern
findings.suggestion: Wrap the lib/data.ts fetchers in query(name) and consume with createAsync, deleting the bespoke cache; it also future-proofs for ssr: "data-only" added in Start 2.1.0

findings.issue: nitro is pinned to a datestamped RC (3.0.261029-rc) whose semver range won't match the next dated RC (different patch tuple) or guard against v3's documented beta-to-RC breaking changes
findings.suggestion: Track nitro releases actively and bump when v3.0 stable lands; budget one config-touching upgrade (nitro changelog documents breaking changes per release)

findings.issue: No devDependencies at all — no typescript, no typecheck script — despite strict tsconfig.json and interface-heavy code
findings.suggestion: Add typescript as a devDependency and a "typecheck": "tsc" script so the boundary types actually enforce anything

findings.issue: Media and API proxies buffer entire responses via arrayBuffer() through app-server memory
findings.suggestion: Stream with new Response(res.body, { status, headers }) instead

findings.issue: API_BASE URL construction duplicated across both proxy routes
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared lib/server/upstream.ts helper so the API origin is defined once

findings.issue: document.documentElement.lang = "en" side effect at component creation, redundant with entry-server.tsx:7's <html lang="en"> and dead weight if SSR is ever enabled
findings.suggestion: Delete it; the document shell already sets lang

findings.issue: .map() used in JSX for reactive lists (also PokemonCard.tsx:35) instead of <For>, losing keyed reconciliation and re-running the whole expression
idFromUrl parses IDs with a regex while apiPathFromUrl (line 60) uses new URL() — inconsistent URL handling
findings.suggestion: Use URL parsing in both, or a single well-tested helper

summary: This is a genuinely current-generation SolidStart app: Start 2.1.0, router 1.0, solid 1.9 (correctly not the 2.0 RC), Vite 8 with the v2 nitro/vite plugin, APIEvent-typed routes, and zero dependencies beyond the framework's own required stack. The platform is used natively (fetch, Headers, URLSearchParams, lazy images, CSS custom properties) and all data access is centralized behind two modules with typed view-models at the component boundary. What it loses points for is re-implementing framework machinery — a TTL/dedupe cache and module promise memoization where router query/createAsync is the documented pattern — and letting raw API payloads through as any with no typecheck tooling to catch drift.

apis.replacement: query + createAsync from @solidjs/router (documented v2 data-fetching pattern; createResource remains supported — createAsync wraps it)
